verdict: the available information does not permit a defensible quantitative model comparison; no delta, RMSE or exceedance is computed for this group
reasons: The measurements are end-of-irradiation compact-level or capsule-level values (about 4100 particles in matrix per compact, about 49 200 per capsule), including particles with failed SiC; none is a time series of one particle.

The configuration Part XII names (generation and decay on, constant time-averaged temperature) cannot be run for 110mAg or 134Cs: activation products without a generation model (decision 15). The nuclides with a generation model (Sr-90, Cs-137) have no in-pile cumulative release measurement in the extracted set.

The temperatures are calculated time-averaged values per compact (955-1136 C) and per capsule (1002-1087 C) from varying daily histories that are not held; Part XII forbids treating the range as one constant-temperature test.
